title: Stone Bridge
scope: Stone Bridge (Saint Petersburg) exterior: a single broad granite arch with a continuous open masonry vault, wedge-shaped arch ring, coursed spandrels, rounded cornice, cambered two-carriageway deck, two outer walks, ten capped granite parapet piers and iron oval-loop railing panels. Short skewed bearing aprons meet mapped approaches.
axis: +X crosses southeast along Gorokhovaya Street; -X faces northwest. +Z faces the southwestern canal reach.

groundCutout.basis: Retained skew-ended bridge deck footprint only. Independent banks, roads and buildings remain native.
